description: Create, update or delete a Number Card or Dashboard Chart (counts, sums, trends, group-by) and optionally place it on a workspace; checks fields and filters with Frappe's rules and computes the real value as a preview (needs approval)

operation.description: Cards and charts have no disabled flag: delete removes one (its undo recreates it)

name.description: The Number Card name / Dashboard Chart chart_name (create: the new name)

definition.description: Frappe field names. number_card: {type:'Document Type'|'Report', document_type, parent_document_type (child tables), function:'Count'|'Sum'|'Average'|'Minimum'|'Maximum', aggregate_function_based_on (numeric field), filters, report_name, report_field, report_function, label, is_public, show_percentage_stats, stats_time_interval, color, currency}. chart: {chart_type:'Count'|'Sum'|'Average'|'Group By'|'Report', document_type, based_on (Date/Datetime field or creation), value_based_on (numeric, Sum/Average), timespan:'Last Year'|'Last Quarter'|'Last Month'|'Last Week'|'Select Date Range', from_date, to_date, time_interval:'Yearly'|'Quarterly'|'Monthly'|'Weekly'|'Daily', group_by_based_on (Link/Select field or owner), group_by_type, aggregate_function_based_on, number_of_groups, report_name, x_field, y_axis:[fields], use_report_chart, filters, type:'Line'|'Bar'|'Percentage'|'Pie'|'Donut'|'Heatmap', is_public, roles:[...], color}. filters: [[fieldname, operator, value]] or {fieldname: value} (Report types: an object of report filter values). Operators: = != > < >= <= in, not in, like, not like, between, is ('set'/'not set'), Timespan ('this month', 'last 30 days'…)

workspace.description: Place it on an existing non-app workspace: a name, {name, label, col: 3|4|6|8|12}, or a list of them
